outputs.explanation: The lower bar graph in panel A shows mean HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) with SD error bars only across N=4 mice, n>100 cells; no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
The lower bar graph shows mean % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells with SD error bars (N=4, n>400) but no individual data points are shown.
Panel C is a western blot, not a plot showing averaged data; the check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot tracking rotarod performance over weeks; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel E consists of line plots across days for different weeks; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot), which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G shows micrographs of histological staining, not a plot; the check does not apply.
Both bar graphs (molecular layer thickness and number of Purkinje cells) show mean ± SD (N=3, n=9) without any overlaid individual data points.
